messages:
jenny (Support): HexaPay on Dedicated eu-west-pool-7 reporting repeated 429s and latency spikes since ~03:12 UTC. They say checkout failures for short bursts — scale up then immediate scale down, lots of transient 429s. Escalating to SRE.

maria (Oncall): taking a look. pulling autoscaler events + pool metrics now.

deploy-bot: [autoscaler] pool=eu-west-pool-7 event=scale_up target=8 -> 16 reason='queue_depth>threshold' ts=3167890201
deploy-bot: [autoscaler] pool=eu-west-pool-7 event=scale_down target=16 -> 8 reason='cooldown_elapsed' ts=3167890274

eli (SRE): can you paste the last 5 autoscaler events and a couple of sample request traces? sounds like a short-period oscillation. also need tenant id from HexaPay.

jenny (Support): tenant=hexapay-tenant-42. attaching sample logs from customer (they included) — see below: 

```
[03:12:02] request id=abc123 tenant=hexapay-tenant-42 latency=45ms status=200
[03:12:03] request id=def456 tenant=hexapay-tenant-42 concurrency=128 latency=1800ms status=200
[03:12:04] autoscaler: scale_up -> 16
[03:12:05] request id=ghi789 tenant=hexapay-tenant-42 latency=1200ms status=429
[03:12:09] autoscaler: scale_down -> 8
[03:12:10] spike: 429s climb
```

sam (Engine Runtime): that timeline smells like 'burst then quick drain' — autoscaler cooldown too short + no smoothing. if requests are short but highly concurrent we can overshoot on scale_up then scale_down immediately. also possible noisy neighbor: another tenant blasting long-running batched calls that temporarily saturate KV cache leading to per-request slowdowns.

eli (SRE): agree. quick mitigation options: 
- increase scale-down cooldown on eu-west-pool-7 to 180-240s
- turn on moving-average smoothing for queue_depth (window ~2-3m)
- temporarily route hexapay-tenant-42 to a different pool or a reserved slot if available

maria (Oncall): can we patch a canary config? if it reduces oscillation, roll to rest of pool.

sam (Engine Runtime): config snippet to try (canary):

```
pool: eu-west-pool-7
autoscaler:
  scale_down_cooldown: 240s
  smoothing_window: 180s
  min_replicas: 8
  scale_up_threshold: 0.75
  scale_down_threshold: 0.35
```

eli (SRE): i'll apply canary to a single AZ shard in eu-west and watch. applying now.

deploy-bot: [config] APPLY -> canary eu-west-pool-7/shard-a user=eli ts=3167890302

maria (Oncall): telemetry starting to show fewer events in canary: scale events in canary 10m window went from 5->1. queue_depth variance down.

jenny (Support): told HexaPay we'll try a mitigation and follow up in ~15min. :thumbsup:

eli (SRE): can confirm canary looks stable after 12m. no new 429 bursts on canary shard. if prod is ok after another 10m we'll promote. logging follow-up: correlate tenant bursts with KV cache churn.

sam (Engine Runtime): long term we should: 
- add tenant burst protections (rate shaping + token buckets per-tenant)
- add prefix/KV warmup to avoid cache cold starts after scale events
- improve autoscaler to look at moving percentile (p95/p99) instead of instantaneous queue_depth for decisions

eli (SRE): created follow-up infra ticket INFRA-1284 (investigate tenant burst patterns + persistent knobs). tagging eng-runtime + customer-success.

maria (Oncall): promoted canary change to whole pool at 03:28 UTC.
deploy-bot: [config] PROMOTE canary -> eu-west-pool-7 user=eli ts=3167890499

jenny (Support): HexaPay confirmed reduced errors on their side, will monitor for an hour and report if anything else.

eli (SRE): postmortem / action items: 
- prod: scale_down_cooldown=240s, smoothing_window=180s (applied)
- follow-up INFRA-1284 assigned to @sam and @eli for deeper noise detection + tenant-level shaping
- CS to offer HexaPay temporary reserved slot if they expect sustained bursts (jenny to coordinate)

maria (Oncall): leaving a note on the pool: "mitigation applied 03:28 UTC — cooldown increased; monitoring for 1h"

jenny (Support): thanks team. I'll update the customer thread and close support ticket once we hit 1h clean. :white_check_mark:
